title: Optimized graph neural network-multilayer perceptron fusion classifier for metastatic prostate cancer detection in Western and Asian populations.
summary: Reactome-constrained GNN P-NETwa with downstream MLP and DeepLIFT attribution selects features and predicts metastatic prostate cancer. 18-gene panel accuracy/F1 .88/.75 internal test and .87/.85 external validation; selected genes are predictive signatures, not proven causal drivers. 1,360 development samples split 80/10/10 and two independent external datasets; retrospective public cohorts and Asian subgroup imbalance constrain use.
